violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: THE SANITIZING STEP OF THE DISHWASHER NEXT TO 3- COMPARTMENT SINK IS NOT VERIFIED. OBSERVED A SANITIZING RINSE CONCENTRATION OF LESS THAN 50PPM CHLORINE SOLUTION,
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. ANOTHER DISHWASHER AND 3- COMPARTMENT SINK WILL BE USED TO SANITIZE ALL FOOD CONTACT SURFACES.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. CFM ORDERED A FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE IMMEDIATELY.

violations.title: Fingernails Maintained
violations.observation: Food employees nails are not maintained so that the edges and surfaces are smooth and cleanable. OBSERVED A FOOD EMPLOYEE HAS PRESS-ON NAILS.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall keep their fingernails trimmed, filed, and maintained so that edges and surfaces are cleanable and not rough. EHS DISCUSSED PRESS-ON NAILS WITH CFM.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. EHS DISCUSSED HARI RESTRAINTS WITH CFM

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: THE DISHWASHER NEXT TO 3-COMPARTMENT SINK IS NOT SANITIZING.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. A WORK ORDER IS PLACED. THE FACILITY WILL NOT USE THIS DISHWASHER BEFORE IT IS REPAIRED.
